routing_description: User-reported diagnostic codes, previously recorded codes and recorded active flags.
planner_instructions: Retrieve recorded code history and preserve each code, timestamp, source and active flag. Active means marked active in the supplied stored context; it is not a live scan. The tools do not decode DTCs and this pack supplies no real code definitions. Do not invent a code meaning or treat a code as proof of a failed part. Cite the generated record evidence reference and distinguish missing history from a confirmed absence of codes.
